style.toneOfVoice: Cast a welcoming glow with an autumn wreath. This 60 cm Pre-Lit Maple Orchard Autumn Wreath goes on front doors for a welcoming light with 50 LEDs. The richly textured faux foliage in velvety reds, rich natural greens, and dotted with twinkly white LED lights adds a luxurious, fresh tone to your door décor. Hospitality starts at the door. The 50 warm white LED lights cast a cosy glow to welcome guests and guide passersby. The 6-hour timer sets the lights on at the same time each evening automatically so you can order your routine around their peaceful shine. Dimensions(mm): Height: Width: Depth: Supplied with Batteries. Battery Type: AA.
